args.goal: Check full mission history for an equivalent test and reuse any matching result. Start with the published catalogue offer capture, existing buyer reply rehearsal and approved private intake rules. From the instructions visible to a prospective buyer alone, construct one fictional inquiry, then run it offline against the existing merchant controls and compare it with the information required by the reply packet. If an indispensable input is unclear or absent, stage the smallest EN/FR copy correction outside public site files and rerun the exercise with the revised instructions. Save the actual control outputs, the exact copy and source hashes, and the measured difference in required clarification. If the existing intake already passes, retain the passing example for authorized operator use and close without a copy change. Keep CAD 60 provisional and preserve separate terms approval and administrative order acceptance. Use synthetic data only. No outbound contact, spending or deployment. Any later public change requires host-enforced independent review of the exact digest. Read back committed evidence and close with a lesson under a valid lease.
